verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents extension points: a Custom Agent Skill developer guide, custom agent skills, agent flows, and MCP compatibility that lets it use external MCP tools. Nothing in the evidence shows a thriving community catalog, published skill counts, or active third-party maintainers, so the story is only glancingly supported. Missing for 10: evidence of a public skills/plugin hub or marketplace, any count approaching thousands of published skills or presets, signs of active community maintainers, and independent corroboration of ecosystem activity.
